title: ArcBuilder
description: ArcBuilder is a feature-rich mod built on the M-Arch library, providing advanced building, destruction, and world management tools.
body:
**✦ 🏗️ ARCBUILDER ✦**




![ArcBuilder](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e57aded27649ea0d01d60fb156db53b8b18c71a6.gif)

**ArcBuilder is a comprehensive, high-performance feature mod designed for modern Minecraft versions.** 

**ArcBuilder is engineered to maximize creativity, efficiency, and user experience.**


![March](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52391f472042e90157a16c36219c2b042e3f47d8_0.webp) **M-Arch Library Integration: Leverages a robust technical core for stable configuration loading, efficient event handling, and cross-mod compatibility.** 

**M-Arch Library Integration:** https://modrinth.com/mod/march

![ArcEnabler](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/208a94c071d44470d447e3c7832cc4327753129e_0.webp) 
**If you want to use this mod on the server side, you need to place this plugin in your server’s plugins folder:** 

**ArcEnabler Server Approval Plugin :** https://modrinth.com/plugin/arcserverapproval



**🌳 TREE | 🍃 LEAF | 🌾 GRASS | 🌼 FLOWER ✦ DESTROY ✦**

**🧹Dedicated modules for Trees, Grass, Flowers, and Entities. Clear vast areas of clutter or unwanted mobs instantly without harming desired structures.**

![Tree,Grass,Flower Destroy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/114e8db15d48946fbd33abb9457ddfc3d7e504de.gif)

**🌧 RAIN | ⚡ THUNDER | ❄️ SNOWFALL | ❄️🌪 THUNDERSTORM | 🏜️💨 SANDSTORM | 💮 END-EFFECT | ✨ STARS-EFFECT ✦ ACTIVATE ✦**

**You can activate all of these effects in the game with a single button. 
Additionally, we have a feature that allows you to quickly adjust the in-game time, as well as a feature to stop the game time completely.**


![Weather](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/566ac99a5aba703d38d31c9336525a844ce4da66.gif)

**🥚 EGG SPAWN | 👾 MONSTER KILL | 🧍‍♂️⚔️ PLAYER KILL ✦ ACTIVATE ✦**

**You can spawn any mob that normally cannot spawn in daylight, and we also have an option to kill them. 
Additionally, there is an option to kill villagers and traders as well.**

![Egg Spawn ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b35bf2f9629517dd40d6a64b80ef8c8bf0e98a0.gif)

![Monster Kill - Player Kill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63e408b1426a655f33a0881ef4d72da84fb57e48.gif)

**⛏️ BREAKS-BLOCKS | 🧱 LAYER-REPLACE | 📐 SMOOTH-SURFACE ✦ ACTIVATE ✦**

**It breaks blocks down to a specified layer and replaces all blocks in that layer with the selected block, creating a smooth and clean surface.**


![Layer Block Fill and Brake](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/230f4cf3bf3b09258e84199a6112c493fba8a00e.gif)

**🔴🔄⚪🔄🟢 BLOCK-CHANGE ✦ ACTIVATE ✦**

**You can replace the block you are holding with any other block. 
If there are blocks you do not want to change, you can mask them using our feature with minecraft:blockname. 
You can even chain masking like this: minecraft:1.blockname,2.blockname,3.blockname...**


![Block Change](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e14b30d17a405ce8dad84ee950900bd377df0e8f.gif)




**🌱 RAPID-TREE-PLANT | 🌳 BLOCK-GROW ✦ ACTIVATE ✦**

**We have a feature that allows the trees we plant to instantly grow to their full size.**

**This feature allows us to plant any type of crop or plant in its fully grown state.**

**Note: If you enable block placement while this feature is active, the plants on the placed blocks will also appear fully grown.**
**For example, when placing a grass_block, any plants on it will grow to their full size.**

![Tree Grow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b26486cd57427ee0efdac441d0031c6092d4b9f.gif)

**🧱✨ SPECIAL BLOCK MANIPULATION ✦ ACTIVATE ✦**

**This feature allows you to stack special blocks in the game without opening their menu. 
It can be a useful option if you want to use these blocks for construction.**

![Special Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f46c39983a3e725e93f0e3b8b9d525efa3c52a39.gif)

**🏗️📏 BLOCK PLACE RANGE | 🛠️ BLOCK-BREAK ✦ ACTIVATE ✦**

**Do you want to increase your block placing range in the game? This feature does exactly that, and it also allows you to break blocks from a distance.**

![Block Range and Break](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/13be0529d56c44fdf9446c48216bf8d4eeb63af2.gif)

**🕊️💨 FLY SPEED BOOST | ⛔ NO STOP ✦ ACTIVATE ✦**

**You can adjust your flying speed as you wish, and we also have a feature that prevents you from getting stuck on obstacles while flying, allowing smooth movement without touching the ground.**

![Fly speed boost](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc4266949d9c88767489140be72c64a5120d280d.gif)
